title: Proposal file — the entries one run proposes to artifacts other skills own
description: One file per proposing run, _concept/proposals/<proposed_on>-<proposed_by>-<scope>.yaml (tree/proposals/README.md § Format). The proposer writes it once; the target's owner later sets only status, settled_by, settled_on and reason of an entry. Dates: validate after turning YAML dates into ISO text, per tree/README.md § Frontmatter every markdown artifact carries.

proposed_by.description: The proposing skill; listed in each target node's may_propose.

scope.description: Kebab slug of what the run worked on, as in the file name: <featureset>-<feature>, a screen id, a topic.

id.description: Unique within the file; cited as <file-stem>#<id>.

target.description: Project-relative path of the owner's artifact: under _concept/, APP-DESIGN.md, or the project glossary.

anchor.description: Where the payload lands, in the grammar the target node's ## Format defines.

payload.description: The entry in the target node's own format: a YAML value, or a markdown string.

source.description: An evidence reference or the user's words.

settled_by.description: The target's owner that settled the entry.
